versions.changelog:
Initial release of code-to-doc-generator.

- Generates multiple types of project documentation (BRD/MRD, PRD, HLD, DDD, LLD, coding guides, test docs, ops/manuals, SLI/SLO, CI/CD) by reverse extracting business logic from code/UI.
- Enforces clear workflow: mode and document type must be confirmed by the user before analysis begins.
- Provides structured, multi-round approach for document generation, tailored to the chosen doc type (including quality/consistency checks).
- Adapts output language and technical depth to the target audience for each document type.
- Supports both new doc generation and reverse-syncing existing docs with code as the source of truth.
- Includes detailed guidelines and quality checklists for each document type, including special requirements for operations and admin manuals.
